import numpy as np
t=np.asarray(df['t']);P=np.asarray(df['P']);y=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'])
L=np.log(P)
o=np.ones_like(P)
Tb=[o,t,t**2]
def err(fs):
    X=np.column_stack(fs); c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((X@c-y)**2)/np.var(y)
best=[]
for n in np.arange(-2,4.01,0.25):
    if abs(n)<1e-9: continue
    Pn=P**n
    fs=[b for b in Tb]+[b*Pn for b in Tb]+[b*L for b in Tb]
    best.append((err(fs),n,'Pn+L'))
    fs=[b for b in Tb]+[b*Pn for b in Tb]+[b*L for b in Tb]+[b*P for b in Tb]
    best.append((err(fs),n,'Pn+L+P'))
best.sort(); print(best[:6])
